qualityPolicy: Appearance/placement guides; minor artifacts recorded without regeneration

boards.title: Stove flare and NPC shutdown
boards.use: Active flame ends at cutoff, but residual smoke remains. Cooking stays blocked during active fire.
boards.note: Guide accepted; exact saved values, lifetimes, anchors and control behavior remain governed by the written design.

boards.title: Water on flame and residual smoke
boards.use: Two independent response variants, one bottled-water unit each. Resolve eligible flame/smoke by the receipt end.
boards.note: Some HUDs duplicate the brain glyph. Build uses one inspection button; water/fire/smoke particles here are mid-animation, not an extra lingering harm state after successful resolution.

boards.title: Power outage and backup heat
boards.use: Backup heat uses wood and matches at the intact existing stove; it does not restore general electricity or create another appliance.
boards.note: The energy-meter fill is generic and must not represent electrical power. A real backup-heat action still needs legal energy and prerequisites from saved state.

boards.title: Window brace and stock-drip diversion
boards.use: An episode brace is not permanent repair. Drip diversion protects threatened stock, not general bodily weather immunity.
boards.note: The brace wood texture is an illustration of the toolkit result, not another wood inventory cost. The stock bottles are illustrative; exact loss target comes from the episode record.

boards.title: Empty, immature and mature rose plot
boards.use: Simple plot-state references. Rose maturity is two growth increments; pixel buds do not determine canonical stage.
boards.note: This is one reusable plot illustrated three ways, not three playable plots. Numerical stage/moisture comes from data.

boards.title: Fertilize versus restore soil
boards.use: One compost queues eligible growth OR restores blocked soil. It grants no simultaneous water, immediate growth and second benefit.
boards.note: The two panels are independent target examples. A visible bud/sparkle is not immediate compost growth; the bonus remains queued until an eligible boundary.

boards.title: Two-plot shelter and one-plot umbrella
boards.use: Wood plus toolkit covers both plots for four living bedtimes; one umbrella covers one plot for three. Creation day counts.
boards.note: Guide accepted; exact saved values, lifetimes, anchors and control behavior remain governed by the written design.

boards.title: Immature dryness and mature persistence
boards.use: An immature planting is removed after two consecutive dry boundaries; an already mature dry plant persists without an invented wilt rule.
boards.note: The third mature-dry example is a separate state comparison, not a wilted plant resurrecting.

boards.title: Construct and move the same chair
boards.use: One optional crafted chair moves between approved anchors without resetting damage/age or replacing baseline leisure.
boards.note: Tools beside the build are action props, not permanent equipment or returned inputs. Only one crafted chair exists; the cushioned base seat is separate.

boards.title: Intact, damaged and bandage-braced chair
boards.use: The temporary bandage brace retains underlying damage and ends by current living bedtime; no healing or renewed chair age.
boards.note: Only this chair leisure variant is blocked by damage; baseline leisure remains available. Close-up scale is not native sprite geometry.

boards.title: Stove damage, active patch and expiry
boards.use: A wood patch lasts two living bedtimes including creation day; expiry removes mitigation and exposes the original damage.
boards.note: Guide accepted; exact saved values, lifetimes, anchors and control behavior remain governed by the written design.

boards.title: Toolkit repairs window and chair
boards.use: Repair consumes one toolkit per independent target example. It needs no wood input and does not renew chair lifetime.
boards.note: Guide accepted; exact saved values, lifetimes, anchors and control behavior remain governed by the written design.

boards.title: Seed-eater diversion and shoo success
boards.use: Independent recorded alternatives: one bread diverts a fixed episode without feeding the rooster; successful shoo uses no supply.
boards.note: The panels are alternatives for a fixed pest episode, not successive attempts after the same episode already ended. Pest artwork adds no autonomous simulation.

boards.title: Tidy and soap deep-clean
boards.use: Tidy clears Mess1 to0 without supplies. Soap deep-clean reduces Mess2 to1; it does not also cure disease or clear every contamination.
boards.note: Remaining crumbs/particles can be animation frames; use the recorded final Mess value. Soap is a whole single-use input.

boards.title: Infection medicine and wound bandage
boards.use: Medicine clears one Infection while Wound remains; bandage clears Wound while established Infection remains. No player live-rescue controls.
boards.note: Reuse the established replay Pause/Skip controls even where this treatment-focused board only shows the event box. Condition icons and meter fills are illustrative.
